sources.snippet: These limitations are part of the educational value: the project makes it easy to see the difference between optimizing a training objective and improving the behavior users actually care about. Build a GPT-style transformer from scratch in PyTorch, then pretrain, fine-tune, align with DPO and PPO/RLHF, and evaluate controlled model experiments.

sources.title: Tiny Transformer
sources.snippet: Tiny Transformer This repository contains an implementation of a simple GPT-like transformer model that can be trained on a single consumer-grade GPU. The code mostly follows along with the videos Let's build GPT: from scratch, in code, spelled out. and Building Makemore by Andrej Karpathy.
